description: This file provides utility functions for making API GET requests, including URL construction, handling of authorization headers, organization ID injection, and response processing. It acts as a wrapper around fetch to streamline API interactions from the frontend.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API endpoints, preferring configured values and falling back to environment variables or a default '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path, correctly handling absolute URLs and special cases involving '/api'.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends the organization_id parameter to the URL if available and not already present.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Main exported function that performs a GET request to a specified path or URL with appropriate headers, URL adjustments, and error handling.
